question: A magic school sends letters to student either by carrier pigeons or owls. A carrier pigeon can carry two letters at a time and requires 3 treats for service. An owl can carry 5 letters at a time and requires 5 treats for service.  At most 40% of the birds can be owls. In addition, the school only has 1000 treats available and at least 20 carrier pigeons must be uses. How many of each bird can be used to maximize the total number of letters that can be sent.

DATA = {
    # "A carrier pigeon can carry two letters at a time"
    "letters_per_pigeon": 2,
    # "An owl can carry 5 letters at a time"
    "letters_per_owl": 5,
    # "requires 3 treats for service" (pigeon)
    "treats_per_pigeon": 3,
    # "requires 5 treats for service" (owl)
    "treats_per_owl": 5,
    # "the school only has 1000 treats available"
    "treats_available": 1000,
    # "At most 40% of the birds can be owls"
    "max_owl_share": 0.40,
    # "at least 20 carrier pigeons must be uses"
    "min_pigeons": 20,
    # index label
    "birds": ["pigeon", "owl"],
    "owls": ["owl"],
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # --- Sets ---
    model.BIRDS = pyo.Set(initialize=d["birds"])
    model.OWLS = pyo.Set(initialize=d["owls"], within=model.BIRDS)

    # --- Variables ---
    # number of each bird used (integer counts, nonnegative)
    model.n = pyo.Var(model.BIRDS, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # --- Objective: maximize total letters sent ---
    def obj_rule(m):
        return (d["letters_per_pigeon"] * m.n["pigeon"]
                + d["letters_per_owl"] * m.n["owl"])

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # --- Constraints ---
    # Treats budget: treats_per_pigeon*pigeons + treats_per_owl*owls <= treats_available
    def treats_rule(m):
        return (d["treats_per_pigeon"] * m.n["pigeon"]
                + d["treats_per_owl"] * m.n["owl"]
                <= d["treats_available"])

    model.treats_limit = pyo.Constraint(rule=treats_rule)

    # At least 20 carrier pigeons
    def min_pigeon_rule(m):
        return m.n["pigeon"] >= d["min_pigeons"]

    model.min_pigeons = pyo.Constraint(rule=min_pigeon_rule)

    # At most 40% of birds are owls: n_owl <= share*(n_pigeon + n_owl)
    # rearranged (linear): (1-share)*n_owl - share*n_pigeon <= 0
    def owl_share_rule(m):
        return ((1 - d["max_owl_share"]) * m.n["owl"]
                - d["max_owl_share"] * m.n["pigeon"]
                <= 0)

    model.owl_share = pyo.Constraint(rule=owl_share_rule)

    return model

}


def build_model(data=None):

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Set of bird types
    model.B = pyo.Set(initialize=d["birds"])

    # Decision variables: number of each bird type used
    model.x = pyo.Var(
        model.B,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers,
        bounds=lambda m, b: (d["min_pigeons"], None)
        if b == "pigeon" else (0, None),
    )

    # Objective: maximize total letters sent
    def obj_rule(m):
        return (d["pigeon_letters"] * m.x["pigeon"]
                + d["owl_letters"] * m.x["owl"])

        return (d["pigeon_treats"] * m.x["pigeon"]
                + d["owl_treats"] * m.x["owl"] <= d["treats_available"])
    model.treats_limit = pyo.Constraint(rule=treats_rule)

    def min_pigeons_rule(m):
        return m.x["pigeon"] >= d["min_pigeons"]
    model.min_pigeons_limit = pyo.Constraint(rule=min_pigeons_rule)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "pigeon_letters": 2,      # letters per carrier pigeon
    "pigeon_treats": 3,       # treats per carrier pigeon
    "owl_letters": 5,         # letters per owl
    "owl_treats": 5,          # treats per owl
    "owl_max_frac": 0.4,      # at most 40% of birds can be owls
    "treats_available": 1000, # total treats available
    "min_pigeons": 20,        # at least 20 carrier pigeons
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # 2. Variables: counts of birds (nonnegative integers)
    model.x = pyo.Var(domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)  # carrier pigeons
    model.y = pyo.Var(domain=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)  # owls

    # 3. Objective: maximize total letters sent
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(
        expr=d["pigeon_letters"] * model.x + d["owl_letters"] * model.y,
        sense=pyo.maximize,
    )

    # 4a. Treats constraint: 3x + 5y <= 1000  (only 1000 treats available)
    model.treats = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=d["pigeon_treats"] * model.x + d["owl_treats"] * model.y
        <= d["treats_available"]
    )

    # 4b. Owl fraction constraint: y <= owl_max_frac * (x + y)
    #     rearrange linearly: (1 - f) y <= f x  ->  (0.6) y <= (0.4) x
    #     multiply through to keep integer coefficients: 3y <= 2x  (<=)
    model.owl_frac = pyo.Constraint(
        expr=(1 - d["owl_max_frac"]) * model.y
        <= d["owl_max_frac"] * model.x
    )

    # 4c. Minimum carrier pigeons: x >= 20  (>=, "at least")
    model.min_pigeons = pyo.Constraint(expr=model.x >= d["min_pigeons"])

    return model
